character.itemUsage: The wandering monk, Saga, joins in on the action wherever she goes.

verificationLimits: Complete native component graphs, selected table ranks, original raw templates and actual animator-to-skeleton pointer chains are retained. Native C# dispatch, particles/audio, modules and frame parity remain unrecovered.

Saga native DAMAGE_IS_UNDEADABLE_THIS_TIME is bridged to a receipt-only HP floor after shields. ON_AFTER_OUTPUT_DAMAGE then applies cripple when current HP is at most1. This does not raise already-low HP, protect HP loss or grant immunity to other attackers. Exact native shared-flag/mitigation/post-output priority and fractional-HP boundaries remain unverified.

Cripple is target-owned, unique and nonrefreshing: unblocked/disabled combat/heal-free and zero regeneration; selected10s trigger InstantKills without source, skips InstantKill in DISAPPEAR then finishes, and InstantKills on BEFORE_APPEAR only while still present. Main-target kill gifts are unforced and respect SP gates. Native rebirth, concurrent cleanse/kill and effect-removal order are not executable-recovered.

Normal first-only Begin and literal Loop hit are composed for a new combat sequence. The separate AnimationController is explicitly uncapped whereas the MeleeAttack ability has maxAnimScale1; local normal playback follows the controller, S3 follows its standalone maxAnimScale1. Exact precedence, cooldown/end-tail overlap and target-loss sequence reset are bounded rather than claimed recovered.

Charge gamma shares the generic charge_cost ability with waitForAttackEvent1 but no own clip or predelay. Its instantaneous DP is bridged to committed automatic activation as in reviewed common charge skills. The native no-animation event dispatcher remains unverified.

S2 native numeric controller event2 grants DP once at committed manual activation, including empty casts. Literal Skill alias hit.333 governs current-range ground selection up to6, and actual .833 clip governs the local cast/SP lock. Its active target buff finishes after absolute .7 seconds, independently of the caster. Numeric controller dispatch, native interrupt/cast-completion phase and cosmetic random Blue/Red branch selection remain unverified; both branches have identical retained gameplay fields.

S3 extends by1 and uses Block-attribute cap with blocked-target priority; SELF/timing0 selects again at release. ON_BUFF_START low-HP extra NORMAL damage is bridged before primary damage using current target HP. Exact native callback/damage ordering and re-selection phase remain explicit interpretation. Original Begin gates attacks without lengthening20s; periodic cost waits1s and delivers20pulses.

Clear Mind table selects .4HP ratio, .7 Physical Dodge, continuous .05/.06 MaxHP regeneration and15/17s once. Native checker has default maxHpRatio1/toggleOnce0 before runtime table configuration; the compiled blackboard-configuration dispatch is not recovered. The local adapter checks LE .4 after HP changes and on tick, once per deployment. Threshold equality and native trigger-frame phase are explicit limits.
Source shaders/audio, S2 colored cosmetic branches and exact animation blend/cooldown overlap are separate work. All prior combat records and source/SD pins remain unchanged.
